name: Aadi Industries Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2009, Aadi Industries 
Ltd is in the business of trading and manufacturing of plastic and plastic 
products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AIL specializes in trading plastic raw materials, catering to diverse sectors. It primarily deals in commodity, engineering, and speciality plastics, with expertise in Commodity Plastics, which form a major part of the petrochemical industry. The company trades in the plastic raw materials:
a) High-Density Polyethylene
b) Low-Density Polyethylene
c) Linear Low-Density Polyethylene
d) Polypropylene
e) Polyvinyl Chloride

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
